name: pi-context-guard
description: Small extension (never published to npm): three context rules — models with a window above 400k tokens compact at 400k instead of Pi's default reserve, the system prompt names the session file so details a compaction summary dropped stay searchable, and stale oversized tool results are pruned deterministically with ctx_reduce/ctx_expand/ctx_search to manage and recover them. Installed from source by install.mjs; kept as a workspace only so CI typecheck/test cover it.
